# Autonomous preset-bank transfer: a simpler comparator to request semantics
30 October 2026. Root new whole-composition candidate, unreviewed. This is on-chip transfer/storage into a predetermined bank, not LOCC, requested on-demand handoff, or universal computation.

## 1. The actual changed task
An unknown state is supplied ALREADY ENCODED on Q at startup, with ready native memory apparatus and every routing clock initialized to0. This small but real clean routing initialization is required: bare encoded Q with arbitrary unknown routing labels is not canonical encoded Q under G. B is an arbitrary logical-independent spare, possibly correlated with the retained bath. The task is to put the state in physical bank B after a finite startup interval and keep it recoverable there. Transfer may begin immediately. There is no promise of remaining in Q until a later request.

This change matters: a hardwired B attractor has no finite unprotected target bit to forget. It directly avoids the allowed local replacement counterexample in REQUEST_DRIVEN_SUBSYSTEM_ROUTER_AND_MODE_OBSTRUCTION.md. It does not solve that counterexample under its original strict request semantics.

# Preset routing: primary comparison and direction
30 October 2026. Root checked full primary HTML, not a novelty clearance.

Kastoryano, Wolf and Eisert, Precisely timing dissipative quantum information processing, arXiv:1205.0985v2 (2012), https://arxiv.org/html/1205.0985v2: main text state-transfer example and Appendix .1 construct dissipative measurement-based transfer along an initialized cluster chain with local correction records and timing gadgets. The clean unknown-state transfer task is therefore prior capability. The present candidate's specific prospective increment is continuous local correlated-noise protection of the transfer and fixed output bank using the retained native memory, not invention of autonomous transfer. The resources differ: paired quantum SWAP access and live memory versus supplied cluster state/classical correction bus. No equal-resource superiority established.

Lebreuilly et al., Autonomous quantum error correction and quantum computation, arXiv:2103.05007v1 (2021), https://arxiv.org/html/2103.05007v1: Appendix IV, Eqs.69–70, explicitly transports code/error sectors to a copied Hilbert space with a gauge ancilla and added engineered dissipation. Thus moving a protected subsystem is also prior machinery. The recovered detailed comparison identifies its specified finite-dimensional Markovian errors and noiseless-copy example; those are distinct from the retained bounded-body joint-bath/native-controller contract. A new robustness theorem using this established mechanism can be useful, but a device or universal result is not inferred.

The preset-bank theorem should be retained as a simpler compiler/comparator, not made the next long sequence of finite-frame variations. It sharply separates recoverable physical location from trustworthy causal execution. The live scientific target remains noisy distributed command semantics, a usable non-deferrable encoded operation, or a stronger independently accessible direction.
